test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven people C, H, A, P, T, E and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). T is sitting to the immediate right of E and to the immediate left of R. Only one person is sitting between E and C when counted from the left of E. Only one person is sitting between R and H when counted from the right of R. Who is sitting to the immediate left of C?
solution:
Given:

Seven people C, H, A, P, T, E and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

T is sitting to the immediate right of E and to the immediate left of R.

Only one person is sitting between E and C when counted from the left of E.

Only one person is sitting between R and H when counted from the right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11122da71ec8eb640cce0b40c0be404ad90da5dfd55de36799000aacb27ef4ac.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24e16c63942024335963cd4df4cbda31bf6fa095e7415602ff719e1eb5980250.png] 

Thus, H sits to the immediate left of C.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
